content:
marco: Night check — planning to open feature_flag model_v13_eu_burst to 1% EU traffic at 22:00 UTC tonight. Needs oncall eyes, metrics, and a quick rollback plan. Anyone object?
anya: :thumbsup: can you post flag name and how you'll flip it?
marco: flag = feature_toggle.model_v13_eu_burst
marco: flip via `./ops/flags set feature_toggle.model_v13_eu_burst 0.01 --region=eu` or from Console. I'll run.
sara: I'll wire up dashboard: latency, 5xx, token_cost, top error messages. Will post link in 15m.
luca (oncall): I'm on rotation tonight, will watch logs and alerts. What's the cutoff if we abort?
marco: abort plan: immediate set to 0, drain existing sessions, rollback to model_v12 variant; escalate to eng-oncall if >0.5% error rate or latency +200ms over baseline for >5m.
qa-bot: Running smoke tests against v13 in staging now — 10/10 passing. Noted small tokenization diff (+0.2% tokens).
anya: Can we limit to authenticated prod only? reduces blast radius.
marco: Good call. We'll scope to auth=true via route rule. Command: `./routes add-rule --flag feature_toggle.model_v13_eu_burst --expr "auth=true && region=eu"`
devops-bot: Reminder: ensure dedicated pool has headroom. Current EU GPU util = 82% (threshold 90%).
sara: Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/abc123/model-v13-eu-slice — added p50/p95 latency, errors, new_tokens metric.
luca (oncall): Subscriptions set. I'll pager if >3% 5xx or p95 >1200ms.
anya: Code review ping @marco for rollout cookbook update.
marco: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/pull/812 — includes toggle commands and rollback script.
sara: I'll add a small smoke eval set and run diffs hourly.
anya: timing: set at 22:00 UTC, any chance 21:30 to avoid EOD overlap?
marco: prefer 22:00 so we get EU team overlap. Locking 22:00. I'll post a short deploy note in #eng-releases 30m prior.
luca (oncall): I'll snooze non-essential alerts and keep only surge alerts active.
devops-bot: Deploybot scheduled job at 22:00: `flip-flag --name feature_toggle.model_v13_eu_burst --value 0.01 --region eu --by marco`
sara: confirming I'll monitor and post updates in this thread. :eyes:
anya: ack. :thumbsup:
